vs_helpers.title: Why not helpers and templates only?
vs_helpers.intro: Helpers are great for one-off math. Hub Énergie is for when you want the same rules, UI, and history as a product integration.
vs_helpers.li1_d: — slot attribution, SSOT totals, costs, diagnostics, and the card read the same snapshot instead of drifting copies.
vs_helpers.li2_d: — fewer template sensors to maintain when your tariff or meter layout changes.
vs_helpers.li3_d: — delta caps, data-quality hints, and rebuild paths are documented and evolve with the integration.
